# Business Impact

Use these metrics only when the application context supports them.

## Usage rule (applies to all achievement figures)

- use "projected savings" when the number is a forecast
- use "selected impact" rather than implying the metric represents the entire organization
- avoid converting percentages into unsupported absolute claims

## Legacy modernization

- R$310k/month projected savings
- +302% ROI over five years
- 19-month payback

## Customer service automation

- approximately R$2M/month reduction in operational cost

## Segmentation

- up to 5x improvement in communication relevance
